milestones.claim: Seven-capability ledger and coverage audit is frozen before implementation.
milestones.doneMeans: A committed audit artifact or command evidence maps each of the seven rows to implemented, partial, missing, already-covered, or retired/non-goal status before runtime changes are claimed done.

milestones.claim: Active Authority Server future backlog language is retired.
milestones.doneMeans: The referenced documents and guards no longer describe Authority Server conformance or production server receipt parity as active future work; remaining names are explicitly legacy compatibility or local/shadow consumer terminology.

milestones.claim: Tier-C cleanup policy is resolved without destroying valid experiment evidence.
milestones.doneMeans: The code and docs either implement the needed Tier-C cleanup behavior or formally retire automatic cleanup while preserving valid Tier-C experiment batches and identifying invalid rows as cleanup-required.

milestones.claim: Append-only admissibility ledger capability is resolved.
milestones.doneMeans: A durable append-only admissibility ledger under .lattice/evidence exists with tests, or the documents and guards explicitly downgrade it to a non-goal while preserving diagnostic waterline semantics.

milestones.claim: Queue cleanup enforcement guard is completed.
milestones.doneMeans: Duplicate/superseded/cleanup-required queue mutation behavior is guarded by tests and implementation while valid Tier-C experiment exceptions remain preserved.

milestones.claim: Runtime closure enforcement rollout is completed or explicitly bounded.
milestones.doneMeans: The current runtime closure enforcement state is verified; enforce mode blocks unsafe lifecycle transitions when configured, docs/config accurately describe rollout and rollback, and no claim says default warn mode is globally enforced unless it is actually configured.

milestones.claim: CommandSpec envelope and project waterline coverage are completed.
milestones.doneMeans: Remaining gate-consumed command evidence surfaces and project-level consumption waterline rollup are covered by tests and docs, or any intentionally deferred surface is listed as non-goal with evidence.
